paragraphs: Evluma makes LED lighting for streets, roadways and outdoor areas. Its area light is pitched at utilities as the standard fixture for that job.

The roadway range is sold by wattage, starting with a 30 to 100 watt streetlight. The largest of them reaches 300 watts. For decorative fixtures the company argues that the point is the right light, not the brightest light. Not every job means a new fixture, since some are solved by retrofitting existing luminaires. Wireless control aimed at cutting maintenance is part of the same catalog.

Evluma traces its perspective on lighting to a background in LED photo-finishing equipment. It says many of its products are patented. The company also runs a supplier diversity program that seeks out small, local, minority, disadvantaged, women-owned, HUBZone and veteran-owned businesses as suppliers. Federal definitions are used for those categories.

quote.text: It’s not about making it cheaper. It’s about making it better and taking the time to do it right.
